capabilities: Render image previews below ![[image.png]] links in Source mode
Show a message when the image file cannot be found
extras: Only works in strict Source mode; Live Preview and Reading View use Obsidian's native rendering. Width must be a pixel number; size combinations like 300x200 and captions are not supported. No telemetry or network requests. Chinese README included.
intentEvidence: But Source Mode has one big catch: you can't see your images.
motivation: The author finds Live Preview's hidden syntax appearing and shifting text ("Editor ADHD") disruptive and wants Source mode to be a complete writing environment by adding image visibility.
problem: Obsidian's Source mode shows no images when writing, and Live Preview's syntax popping in and out disrupts writing flow.
summary: Renders image previews directly below ![[image]] embed links in Obsidian Source mode, where images are otherwise invisible.
